window.note: The operator_inbox end of the same seam (ticket 6ec9b384b451). The phase becomes the inbox's SIEVE: PHASE_INBOX = (blocked, hold) — hold is IN for awareness, which is how its graveyard risk is paid for rather than avoided (Akien, 2026-09-08: 'it should show up in the operator inbox specifically so the operator is kept aware'); waiting and queued are reference, not inbox. status_label stopped dropping every phase but :waiting — sound with two words, catastrophic with five, since the four it dropped are the ones a human needs. label_sort_key's secondary key became PHASE_RANK (who acts next), so within a stage Akien's work sorts above CC's; queued sorts LAST, against the alphabet, which is the tooth that tells a real ordering from an accidentally alphabetical one. And in-process is overlaid at display time from the live sail record, stateless — nothing writes it and nothing has to remember to clear it.
